coverLetter:
Tomas Brandt
Chicago, IL, USA
tomas.brandt@example.com
+1 555 0123

October 12, 2026

Hiring Manager
Okta

Dear Hiring Manager,

Okta is scaling fast in profitable growth mode, and a newly formed Technology organization needs budgeting and forecasting it can trust from day one. I faced a similar problem at Calder Industrial Components, where the forecast for our larger business unit was only 88% accurate. I rebuilt the model around order backlog and brought accuracy up to 96%.

As Financial Analyst, I own the monthly forecast and variance reporting for two business units, so budget vs. actual variance analysis is routine work for me. I also shortened month-end close reporting from 9 working days to 6 by automating journal checks in Excel VBA, which is the kind of process and systems improvement your role calls for. With 5 years of experience in budgeting, forecasting and month-end reporting, plus advanced Excel and Power BI, I'm comfortable turning operational drivers into clear reporting for the business partners I support. I'm also working through my ACCA qualification, with 9 of 13 papers passed. I haven't worked on M&A or pricing models, but I learn quickly and build my own tools when a process needs fixing.

I'd welcome the chance to talk about how this approach could support your team's planning and forecasting. I'm available for a conversation at your convenience.

Kind regards,
Tomas Brandt
